blocks.html: Celebrate the love month right and prepare to experience a complete turnaround of emotions as Robinsons Galleria- Ortigas and Robinsons Place Manila hold a series of exciting and extraordinary events that will redefine your Valentine’s Day celebration. Songs from the heart Get ready to sing songs that will remind you of your first love, or even your first heartbreak. On February 4, 4 pm at Robinsons Galleria activity area, let The Voice Philippines Season 2 winner Jason Dy sing tunes that will definitely melt your heart like All About Me, 365 Days x Forever, and 2HaveU from his latest album under MCA Music entitled All About Me. Singer- songwriter, pianist and Star Music recording artist Marion Aunor will make you feel young –at-heart with her sweet and charming voice. Apart from being the niece of Superstar Nora Aunor, she proved her musicality by winning third place in the 2013 Himig Handog P-Pop Love Songs. Hear her sing her heart out to some of her hits like If You Ever Change Your Mind and I Love You Always Forever on February 5, 5 PM, at Robinsons Galleria activity area. If you are single and ready to fall in love, come to Robinsons Galleria activity area on February 10, 5PM and prepare to be serenaded by the newest acoustic balladeer TJ Monterde, with songs from his self-titled sophomore album - Tulad Mo, Kung Siya Man and Dating Tayo under PolyEast Records. Are you planning to treat your parents or even your titos and titas on Valentine’s day? Robinsons Galleria will be throwing a music jam on February 12, 4pm at the activity area featuring Before and After, a retro band composed of members coming from different professional fields who unite to fulfill their passion for music. What’s more, talented R&B heartthrob Daryl Ong, Teen actor and singer Inigo Pascual, The Next Big Diva Morisette Amon, and Pinoy Got Talent Star Kaye Cal will definitely make your pre-valentine even lovelier as these sought-after artists bring a night full of soulful and sweet music at Midtown Atrium of Robinsons Place Manila. Falling in Laugh No date? No worries! Beat those love blues away as the best of Comedy Manila’s GB Labrador- One of the Philippines international stand-up comedians and performer at The 2016 Melbourne International Comedy Festival; James Caraan- Banana Split's Clown in a Million finalist and host of PTV4's Bara-Bara Anything Goes; Red Ollero- 2014 Hong Kong Comedy Festival finalist and cast member of Bara Bara Anything Goes TV; and Alex Calleja- Boys Night Out Taco Tuesdays DJ and first Runner-Up at the Laugh Factory's Funniest Person In The World Contest take you on an amusing and humorous date on February 11, 6PM at Robinsons Galleria activity area. Who knows? Men can even learn a thing or two on throwing the funniest and cheesiest pick-up lines that can win their woman’s heart. I’m Drunk, I Love You Set your moviedate with your BFFs and watch Maja Salvador and Paulo Avelino’s quirky romantic comedy movie I’m Drunk, I Love You to be shown on February 15. Better yet, head to Robinsons Place Manila Orosa atrium on February 5, 4 pm to catch the cast- Maja Salvador, Paolo Avelino and Dominic Roco. Watch them perform live with special participation of singers from the movie’s original sound track - Ebe Dancel, Johny Danao and Juan Miguel Severo. Love and goodwill What better way to share the love but with the people who needed it most. Join Bailey May and Ylona Garcia as they share the love on Valentine’s Day with the kids from Boystown on February 18, 5pm at Robinsons Galleria activity area and the young PGH Cancer patients on February 19 at Robinsons Place Manila Orosa Atrium. The shows will feature performances from the young lovebirds and ceremonial turnover of the gifts of love to the youth of Boystowne and PGH Cancer patients. To know more about other Robinsons Malls events and Valentine’s Day promos, follow Robinsons Malls in Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter:@RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial.
